"Let's ditch the pleasantries and get right to it."
- Ada Wong before becoming a mindless Umbrella drone

Ada Wong was ambushed and captured while attempting to steal confidential
documents from one of Umbrella Corporation's facilities. She was knocked
out and drugged before being imprisoned in one of Umbrella's most top
secret and secure laboratories, under the direct control of Albert
Wesker.
For a month, she was taken from her cell to the torture room every day
until she finally submitted. Through constant interrogation, Wesker finally
broke Ada's spirit.
She was brainwashed to become an Umbrella agent, her body modified to
make her faster, stronger and sexier. As a result of numerous mind
breaking sessions and body augmentations, she eventually loses her
intelligence and becomes a mindless bimbo under Wesker's orders, who now
uses her as his faithful bitch.
A loyal but deadly Bitch. 🖤

After each mission, Ada returns to Wesker's side, obeying all his orders.
Even if it means getting down on her knees, posing for a photo and then
blowing him off in the middle of the hall as the staff walk by.

That's how obedient she is! 🖤

----------

When finally Jill Valentine was also captured she was immediately brought to Wesker to undergo the same treatment as Ada in order to make her an loyal agent of the Umbrella Corporation.
Just as Ada lost her identity when she became Agent #01 Jill would now be known as Agent #02 ready to stand by Wesker's side with the same obedience. 🖤

----------

"Everything for you master~~!"
If Wesker is accompanied by Agents #1 and #2 it's not for his own safety — he can defend himself perfectly well alone — but rather so that he can use them as sex toys whenever he wants.
After all, having such an important and stressful role within the Umbrella Corporation deserves a few advantages.

----------

"Many weeks after their mysterious disappearance, Ada and Jill suddenly returned to Claire, Christ, Rebecca, and Leon. But something was wrong with them, as if something had changed...
Maybe it just their new look?"

----------
Claire and Rebecca's Final Test
After successfully turning them over to Umbrella's side, Ada and Jill brought Claire and Rebecca to Wesker's secret laboratory to begin their training. But would they be able to endure the trials required to become elite Umbrella soldiers? Nothing could be less certain - Wesker is known for wanting...

----------
Every time Wesker's new secret weapon is transferred from one lab to another Ada is in charge of escorting it. But let's just say she has a rather unique way of securing her 7-foot VIP... a unique way that might explain why Mr.X is always so tense when he sees her. Either that or it’s her outfit and the pheromones Ada releases that make it nearly impossible for Mr. X to stay calm and not grope her during the transfer!

----------
Wesker loves taking his most loyal pet for a daily walk through the Umbrella Corporation’s high-security prison. He enjoys seeing the envy on the faces of the prisoners locked up here and on rare occasions he even lets them play with his toy when he has to punish Ada for her failures. Ada pretends not to like it to please her master but in reality being the masochist that she is she savours every moment!
